Class BaseWeapon

java.lang.Object
model.weapon.BaseWeapon
All Implemented Interfaces:
Updatable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Bow, Gun, Staff
public abstract class BaseWeapon extends Object implements Updatable
Abstract base class for all weapon types. Provides common functionality for damage, attack speed, and cooldown management. Subclasses define specific projectile patterns and behaviors.

  • Constructor Details

    • BaseWeapon

      public BaseWeapon(double damage, double attackSpeed, double cooldownRemaining, String imagePath, double width, double height)
      Constructs a new weapon with the given stats and projectile visuals.
      Parameters:
      damage - base damage per projectile
      attackSpeed - attacks per second
      cooldownRemaining - initial cooldown (usually 0 to fire immediately)
      imagePath - path to projectile sprite
      width - projectile width in pixels
      height - projectile height in pixels

  • Method Details

    • attack

      public abstract List<Projectile> attack(Vec2 origin, Vec2 target)
      Fires this weapon, creating one or more projectiles. Subclasses define the projectile pattern (single shot, spread, etc.).
      Parameters:
      origin - world position to fire from (usually player center)
      target - world position to aim toward (usually nearest enemy)
      Returns:
      list of projectiles to spawn

      Parameters:
